instruction: Access the webpage https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/searching and copy the content about search field implementation into a new document. Save the document as "search_field_guide.docx" on your desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple HIG search page and extracting search field implementation content. Evaluator verifies document has adequate content length and non-empty paragraphs. Similar to original in web-to-document workflow.

llm_judge_reasons: Insufficient semantic verification: Evaluator only checks min 80 characters and 1 paragraph, which cannot distinguish between correct content about search field implementation vs any random text
No URL content validation: No verification that content was actually copied from the specified URL (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/searching)
No topic validation: Cannot verify that content is actually about 'search field implementation' as required by instruction
Threshold too low: 80 characters is far too low for meaningful content from a technical documentation page (could be just a title or random sentence)
Missing coverage: Instruction requires copying specific content from specific webpage, but evaluator only verifies that some document with minimal text exists
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add keyword validation: Check for presence of relevant terms like 'search', 'field', 'implementation', 'placeholder', 'icon', etc. that would appear in search field implementation documentation
Increase character threshold: Raise min_char_count to at least 500-1000 characters to ensure substantial content was copied
Add paragraph count validation: Require multiple paragraphs (e.g., 3-5) to ensure comprehensive content was extracted
Consider URL validation: If possible, verify that browser history shows the specified URL was accessed
Add content structure checks: Verify document contains expected sections or formatting typical of technical documentation
